quest.title: The Culling of the Worms: Presentation
quest.description: Based on Shriya's reasoning, you have successfully found where the root of the problem is...

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Sure enough, the charging unit is running more smoothly... As you said, the elemental environment in this area is returning to normal.

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: ...The activity of affected Wenut will calm down after some time, too.

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: Yeah, yeah... Thanks to your precious Wenutslayer Cannon, we can report back our success and go home.

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: It's OUR precious Wenutslayer Cannon, Shriya. I never forgot that this assignment was a joint effort.

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: ...We definitely had our share of disagreements, but without you, the cannon wouldn't have been a success.

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: What's... gotten into you? Is this about wanting me to put in a good word for you in my report?

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Well, I just suddenly feel that what we went through just now is quite similar to our experience from that other year: it wasn't always smooth sailing, but we still made it in the end.

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: And let's face it. In the end, your solution proved more efficient.

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: I... uh... I can't take all the credit...

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: ...Because you were onto something, too. If you hadn't tested the Wenutslayer Cannon, I wouldn't have obtained the necessary data...

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: "To fix a machine you may only need to replace one gear, but the true challenge is finding that gear..." These words from my mentor are beginning to make sense to me.

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: I'm so glad you're here, Shriya.

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: Uh... I'm glad you're here, too...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? The atmosphere between these two became so different all of a sudden...

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: Ahem! When we were cooperating on our graduation project, our relationship was rather rocky because we weren't very mature.

response.speaker: Vinayak
response.text: Yeah. Looking back on it, it wasn't anything too serious...

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: Well... How about meeting at the café for a drink next time? We could discuss how to write the report.
